answer.book: Philosophiae naturalis adversus Aristotelem libri XII (Sebastiano Basso, Amsterdam, Elzevier 1649): one work in twelve books, grouped under eight treatise titles (De materia et mixto, De forma, De natura et anima mundi, De motu, De actione, De coelo, De visu, Meteorologicorum); each book is divided into intentiones and articuli, with a dedication and an address to the reader at the front and a subject index at the back.
